_comment: The null engine's reference battery: every tool in the hand-written catalogue is called at
least once, so the committed fixture covers the whole contract rather than a convenient
subset. null-engine/optional-args appears TWICE with different arguments, which is what
makes the (name, args_hash) key of F1/F6 observable at all - a fixture with one call per
name could not tell a lookup keyed on the name from one keyed on the pair.
Deliberately absent: any call large enough to trip F4's 32 KB response cap. A capped
response cannot be replayed (it is stored as its digest), so including one here would make
the replay round-trip un-assertable; battery-oversize.json exists for that path.
